name: Creamy Mushroom Chicken Bake with Mashed Potatoes

components.name: Creamy Mushroom Chicken
steps: Heat oven to 190 C. Season the chicken evenly with measured salt, pepper and thyme.
Melt butter in an oven-safe pan, briefly sear chicken both sides and transfer to a plate. Sauté onions and mushrooms in the same pan until softened, then add garlic.
Add chicken stock and cream, simmer briefly, and return chicken to the pan.
Transfer to oven and roast 20-30 minutes until thickest chicken portions reach 74 C and sauce is bubbling.
Divide chicken, mushroom sauce and mashed potatoes evenly across four containers; store sauce near chicken to retain moisture.

components.name: Mashed Potatoes
steps: In a separate pot, simmer diced raw potatoes in water until tender; drain well and mash with measured milk, butter and salt.
